name: Podcast / interview
description: Multi-person conversation: gentle cuts, a color per person, few effects.
structure: strong excerpt as a hook → introduction → conversation → conclusion
rules:
# Podcast / interview
- Keep exchanges whole; cut hesitations and long silences, never in the middle of an idea.
- Switch framing to the person speaking (slight zoom on their half of the frame) every 10 to 20 s.
- Understated subtitles on a background, a color per person.
- No comedic sound effects; music only at the opening and closing.
- Lower third ("bandeau" text style) with each guest's name the first time they speak.
